input.free_text_description: This system is a search platform that serves Admin, Content Creator roles. The platform provides capabilities for elastic search, elastic search, elastic search indices. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Admin, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a Admin, I want to interact with charging station detail functionality, so that I can accomplish my charging station detail-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to interact with charging station map indexer functionality, so that I can accomplish my charging station map indexer-related tasks.
